!E-SHSTB15-25  # p.541 note: E-SHSTB15 is not available with H = 25
!E-SHSTM8-35  # H = 35 is not in the D8 selection (10 15 20 25 30 40)
!E-SHSTA8-20  # aluminium type only for * marked dimensions: D8 is not marked
!E-SHSTA10-25  # aluminium D10 only with H = 20
!E-SHSTMN10-10  # E-SHSTMN is not applicable to the * marked D10 (p.542)
!E-SHSTM9-20  # D9 is not a catalogue size
!E-SHSTM8  # the height H is missing
!C-SHA10-20  # C-SHA has one fixed height per D, no H in the part number
!C-SHA8  # C-SHA is listed for D 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 30
!E-SHWTB25-30  # E-SHWT has no D25 (D 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 30)
